# Pixel Tip Calculator

A finished, offline, keyboard-accessible pixel-styled tip calculator. Enter a bill amount, pick a tip percentage (10%, 15%, or 20%), and set the number of people to see the tip and total per person.

## Features

- Bill amount input with decimal support
- Tip percent buttons (10, 15, 20) with clear selected state
- Party size input with division-by-zero guard
- Live results for tip per person and total per person
- Fully keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive layout that works from 360px wide

## How to run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server, build step, or network connection required.

## Files

- `index.html` — semantic page structure and controls
- `styles.css` — pixel-art theme, palette, and responsive layout
- `app.js` — calculation logic and event wiring

## Palette

- Background: `#1a1a2e`
- Card / inputs: `#16213e` / `#0f3460`
- Accent: `#e94560`
- Text: `#eaeaea` / `#a0a0b0`
